channel.title: Indifferent journal
channel.description: Guides to the AI Shorts generator, the TXT to quiz video generator and the watermark tool.

item.title: Video Effects for Shorts: Zoom, Grade, Speed and More
item.description: Every video effect in the AI Shorts generator with its exact limits: zoom, color grade, speed ramping, freeze frames, shake, finish, fade, waveform and the five presets.

item.title: How to Turn a Podcast into YouTube Shorts
item.description: Prepare an episode, upload it, pick the right language and review three ranked clips. A practical workflow with limits, file-size maths and fixes.

item.title: How to Add Animated Captions to Shorts
item.description: Word-by-word captions from transcript timestamps: the four presets, the animated captions effect, colours, safe positions and Hindi text.

item.title: How AI Video Clipping Works, Step by Step
item.description: What happens between upload and download: transcription, ranking, snapping to word edges, face-based framing and rendering, and where it can go wrong.

item.title: How to Convert Landscape Footage into Vertical Video
item.description: Center crop, face-aware crop or blur-fill: the 16:9 to 9:16 maths, ffmpeg commands you can run yourself, and how each clip is framed.

item.title: How to Add a Watermark to an Image in Your Browser
item.description: Step-by-step guide to text and logo watermarks in the free in-browser tool: formats, opacity, placement, export options, privacy and troubleshooting.

item.title: MP4 vs WebM: Formats, Compatibility and File Size
item.description: Containers are not codecs. What MP4 and WebM hold, where each plays, how to convert between them with ffmpeg, and which one to upload.

item.title: How to Create Quiz Videos for YouTube
item.description: Learn how to create engaging quiz videos for YouTube: formats, scripting, narration, and publishing interactive trivia content viewers love.

item.title: Best Practices for Educational Video Content
item.description: Design better educational videos: structure, slide design, narration pacing, accessibility, and measuring learning outcomes.

item.title: Quiz File Format Guide: TXT Formatting Tips
item.description: Format quiz TXT files correctly: numbered, bulleted and tab-indented patterns, answer markers, and common mistakes to avoid.

item.title: AI Narration for Videos: A Complete Guide
item.description: A complete guide to AI narration for videos: voices, pacing, pronunciation, and how to get natural-sounding voiceovers with Amazon Polly.
